title: Once the kit's close closed its store, the kit refuses a read with kit_closed, never the store's own error, and the store refuses a write
notes: Python: tests/test_kit_close.py::test_a_read_answers_during_the_close_and_after_it_while_its_store_is_open. The store is one the kit closes (setup.kit.store_owner kit): once closed it refuses every operation, as a closed store fails them. The read through the kit is refused naming the close; the write made through the store after the close is refused by the store (store_failed). The writer here is a call made once the close returned, not work abandoned by the close's cut: what such work writes afterwards meets the same store.
